工部局警察近く大異動發表
英幹部は總退却
署長級を日本隊で強化

工部局警察當局に於ける十五日午後四時半分から工部局総務處事務室に開かれた臨時會議に於て、工部局全警察署長及副署長等が出席し、今後の治安維持策等に就き協議した結果、左の如き重要なる決定を見た。即ち英人署長級の總退却と之に代る日本人署長の任命である。尚ほ此の件に就ては近日中に正式發表を見る筈であるが、大体に於て左の如く傳へられている。

一聽されたのであつた、しかし當時の警察員は十二ケ國二千七百餘名であり內日本隊は三百八十九名といふ貧弱な陣容をはじめてゐたから警務處外人として日本人を副署長、巡捕房主任として實務習得期間を約六ケ月間と豫定してゐたがその間四局長の日本人就任と

なり、ことに第三次改組の好機が到來したので、全職の署長、巡捕房主任は全部日本隊によつて強化されることになるわけである、またこれに伴ひ中級幹部の全面的な大移動と英人幹部の第二次退却が實施されることになり近く發表される模様で日本隊の變動は頗る注目されてゐる。

同異動の一大眼目は警務活動の

主腦をたす專らねぶ刑事主任をすべて日本籍役員にすると同時に英人職員は不用と認むるものおよび排日傾向濃厚なる者をすべて罷免して人事の刷新を図るとともに工部局財政の節約を目的するもので、同異動實施後租界内に對する我が當局施策の効果を擧ぐる爲ともども犯罪防止策を講じて安寧明朗の首都たらせめんとする方針である

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper):
"FINANCIAL MARKET IN SHANGHAI IN DANGER: GREAT CHANGES
EXPECTED IN NEAR FUTURE"

The Ministry of Finance of the Kuomintang is
restricting the circulation of legal tender notes. As
a result, Chinese banks in Shanghai are limiting their
loan business and are not in a position to regulate the
financial market in this locality. Local banks are in
financial difficulties although ostensibly they appear
to be in good condition.
According to a certain economic expert, the
financial market in Shanghai will collapse should the
war in China be prolonged for another year. Local
bankers are uneasy.
It is learned that the Ministry of Finance
of the Kuomintang held a meeting recently at the request
of Shanghai banking circles because the latter had asked
the authorities to reveal the truth about upholding the
financial market in Shanghai.
Changes may take place in banking circles
in Shanghai, changes quite unexpected by the public.

《新申报》（日资中文报纸）：
“上海金融市场告急：近期预料将发生剧变”

国民党财政部正在限制法币的流通。结果，上海的华商银行正在收紧贷款业务，无法调控本地金融市场。本地银行虽表面上看似状况良好，实则陷入财政困境。
据某经济专家称，若中国的战争再延长一年，上海的金融市场将会崩溃。本地银行家对此深感不安。
据悉，国民党财政部最近应上海银行业界的要求举行了会议，因为后者要求当局透露关于维持上海金融市场稳定的真相。
上海银行业界可能会发生公众意想不到的变化。

Date April 14 1938.

Subject Alleged anti-Chiang Kai Shek activities in Fokien.

Made by.................... and .................... Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

Referring to the report of Sin Shun Pao of April 13
on the above subject, enquiries show that the allegations
contained therein are mostly unfounded.

The province of Fokien is under the control of General
Chen Yi, ex-Vice Minister of War who is known as a loyal
supporter of Chiang Kai Shek.

Japan has always been anxious to create trouble in
that province owing to its proximity to Formosa. The rebellion
of the 19th Route Army which was followed by the establishment
of a Provisional Government in 1933 was suppressed after a
brief fighting. The leaders all fled and their soldiers were
disbanded, some being re-organized into the forces at Canton.

It is true that the interior of the province is infested
by bandits but this has no political significance for such
conditions prevail in nearly every province.

General Chen Chi Tang, the former Governor of Kwangtung,
is not in Fokien and has no connection with the 19th Route Army
while the former commanders of the defunct army such as Li Chi
Sun, Chen Ming Chu and Tsai Ting Kai, who took part in the
rebellion have been pardoned by the Hankow Government through
the recommendation of Mr. T.V.Soong and have offered their
services against the Japanese whom they fought brilliantly in
Shanghai in 1932.

General Chen Yi, the Governor of Fokien, has a Japanese
wife but he has been in this post for 3 or 4 years and his
loyalty towards the Hankow Government is believed to be above
suspicion.

事由：据传在福建发生的反蒋介石活动。

呈报人：.................... 及 .................... 呈转人：警司谭绍良。

针对《新申报》4月13日关于上述事由的报道，经调查表明，其所载指控大多毫无根据。

福建省目前由前军政部次长陈仪将军控制，他被公认为蒋介石的忠实支持者。

由于该省毗邻台湾（Formosa），日本一直急于在该省制造事端。十九路军于1933年发动叛乱并成立临时政府，在经过短暂战斗后被镇压。首领全部逃亡，其士兵被解散，部分被整编入广州的军队中。

该省内地确实土匪横行，但这并无政治意图，因为几乎每个省份都普遍存在这种情况。

前广东省政府主席陈济棠将军并不在福建，与十九路军亦无联系；而曾参与叛乱的已解散军队的前指挥官如李济深、陈铭枢和蔡廷锴，已在宋子文先生的推荐下获得汉口政府的赦免，并已表示愿意抗日——他们曾在1932年的上海战役中与日军进行过英勇的战斗。

福建省主席陈仪将军虽有一位日本妻子，但他担任此职已有三四年，其对汉口政府的忠诚被认为是无可置疑的。

April 13, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
publishes the following article :-

ANTI-CHIANG KAI-SHEK CONDITIONS IN FOKIEN PROVINCE

The establishment of a pro-Japanese and
anti-Communist "Reformed Government of the Chinese
Republic" in Central China has had serious consequences
upon the whole of China. It is receiving attention from
the public because of the fact that nearly all the members
of this new government are natives of Fokien Province.
Fokien Province has always been the
cradle of anti-Chiang Kai-shek activities and was the
site of the People's Government established in 1935 by
General Chen Min-chu (陈铭枢), General Li Chi-sen
(李济深), General Tsai Ting-kai (蔡廷锴), General
Huang Chi-ziang (黄琪翔) and other well-known Chinese
militarists and politicians. The province is also infested
with communistic tendencies. Consequently, the inhabitants
of this province are fairly acquainted with whatever
political developments that may have taken place in this
country.

Since the outbreak of the present
Sino-Japanese hostilities, a strict surveillance has been
maintained by the National Government on all movements
in Fokien Province, because the National Government has
always had the intention of bringing Fokien under its
military control and enforcing a positive military
training among the people of the province. However,
contrary to the expectations of the National Government,
the province is strongly against Chiang Kai-shek.
Realizing the gravity of the situation
prevailing in Fokien Province, the National Government,
as a compromise, intends to appoint General Chen Chi-tang
(陈济棠), the former Governor of Kwangtung Province,
as Chairman of the Fokien Provincial Government in
succession to General Chen Yi (陈仪). However, due to
the detention of his wife as well as to the fact that no
official recognition has so far been forthcoming from the
Central Government regarding his donation of $70,000,000,
General Chen Chi-tang declined the post.

1938年4月13日下午译文。

《新申报》（日资中文报纸）发表了以下文章：-

福建省之反蒋状况

华中地区亲日防共的“中华民国维新政府”之建立，对整个中国产生了严重后果。由于这一新政府的成员几乎全为福建省籍，因而引起了公众的关注。
福建省历来是反蒋活动的温床，且是陈铭枢将军、李济深将军、蔡廷锴将军、黄琪翔将军及其他中国知名军政界人士于1935年（译者注：原文如此，实际应为1933年）建立的人民政府所在地。该省亦充斥着共产主义倾向。因此，该省居民对国内发生的任何政治事态发展都相当熟悉。

自当前中日敌对行动爆发以来，国民政府对福建省的一切动向都保持着严密监视，因为国民政府一直意图将福建置于其军事控制之下，并在该省人民中实施积极的军事训练。然而，与国民政府的预期相反，该省强烈反对蒋介石。
国民政府认识到福建省局势的严重性，作为妥协，意图任命前广东省政府主席陈济棠将军接替陈仪将军担任福建省政府主席。然而，由于其妻子被扣押，加之中央政府迄今对其捐款70,000,000元一事未予官方承认，陈济棠将军谢绝了这一任命。

Date March 30 1938.

Subject Report of an Autonomous Government being formed at Canton.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

The report in the Sin Shun Pao (a Japanese owned publication in Chinese) of March 28 on the above subject cannot be confirmed and is believed to be highly exaggerated.

There is some disagreement between General Wu Te Chen, the Civil Governor of Kwangtung and General Yu Han Mou, the Military Governor, over certain matters concerning the administration in the province. General Yu who assumed the highest command of the troops in the province as a result of the Coup in Kwangtung in 1936, has always interfered with civil appointments and on one occasion he even forced the Provincial Treasurer, Mr. Soong Ts Liang, brother of Mr. T.V.Soong, and the Salt Commissioner, Mr. H.O. Tong, to leave their posts.

General Wu Te Chen knew before leaving Shanghai that he would have to submit to the orders of General Yu. Therefore he postponed his departure twice until the receipt of a telegram from General Yu offering his cooperation. However, it is impossible for General Wu Te Chen to form a government independent of Hankow to deal with General Yu Han Mou who is being backed up by a large military force. Such a step will immediately cause the downfall of General Wu Te Chen and may even endanger his life. Political intriguers appear to be active at Canton but they are mostly the former followers of General Chen Chi Tang, ex-Military Governor of Kwangtung and it is not likely that a man of keen intelligence like General Wu would fall into their trap.

广东省政府主席吴铁城将军与军事长官余汉谋将军在有关该省行政的某些事务上存在分歧。因1936年广东事变而担任该省军队最高指挥权的余将军，一直干预文官任命，甚至曾一度逼迫省财政厅长宋子良先生（宋子文先生之弟）及盐务管理局局长唐海安先生离职。

Sin Shun Pao (the Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper)
published the following article on March 28 :-

AN AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IS BEING STARTED BY GENERAL
WU TEH-CHEN IN KWANGTUNG

According to recent arrivals from Kwangtung,
the Chinese residents in that province, seeing what is
going on in the Japanese occupied areas, are gradually
becoming dissatisfied with the war of resistance and
have changed their attitude. General Wu Teh-chen
himself is said to be on bad terms with the other
officials of the Kwangtung Provincial Government and with
General Yu Han-mou, the supporter of General Chiang
Kai-shek. General Wu is at present promoting an autonomous
movement in Kwangtung.

General Yu Han-mou is now in an isolated
position in Canton where the people are becoming more
and more favourable towards the autonomous movement
being prepared by General Wu Teh-chen. It is possible
that a South-west Government will soon be established
in Kwangtung.

《新申报》（日资中文报纸）于3月28日发表了以下文章：-

吴铁城将军在广东发起自治运动

据近期从广东抵沪的人士透露，该省的中国居民在目睹了日军占领区的情况后，逐渐对抗战产生不满并改变了态度。吴铁城将军本人据传与广东省政府的其他官员以及蒋介石的支持者余汉谋将军关系恶劣。吴将军目前正在广东推动自治运动。

余汉谋将军目前在广州处于孤立状态，而当地民众对吴铁城将军正筹备的自治运动表现得越来越支持。广东可能很快就会建立起一个西南政府。

SHANGHAI TIMES,

JAN 1 2 1939

Alleged Estrangement Seen
In Gen. Chiang's Family

Rupture Reported As Result Of General's Son
Adopting Hostile Attitude Towards Madame;
Influence Of Communists Behind Move

TOKYO, Jan. 11.—Friction between Madame Chiang Kai-shek, Christian wife of General Chiang Kai-shek, and Chiang Ching-kuo, "Red" son of the Chinese military leader, is threatening to develop into a first-class "war" in Chungking's "first family," the Hongkong correspondent of the "Asahi" chain of newspapers said in a despatch published here to-day.

Basing his report of information secured from a prominent Chinese refugee in Hongkong, the correspondent said Madame Chiang had served an ultimatum on her husband. Demanded by her were:
1.—A prohibition to Chiang Ching-kuo, or his mother, Mrs. Chen Chieh-ju, to enter the official residence of General Chiang, or
2.—To grant Mme. Chiang a separation.

The trouble, the correspondent quoted his informant as saying, arose from the constant remonstrations by Chiang Ching-kuo against the interference by Mme. Chiang in—Domestic politics. Chiang Ching-kuo returned from Moscow in 1937 after a lengthy estrangement during which he denounced his father recounting General Chiang's alleged brutal treatment of Mrs. Chen Chieh-ju.

Adopts New Tactics

When these complaints had little result, Chiang Ching-kuo is alleged to have resorted to new tactics. He began taking his mother into high Chinese society in Chungking where he respectfully introduced her as "my mother."

This so irritated Mme. Chiang that she served an ultimatum upon her husband.

General Chiang, the correspondent pointed out, found himself on the horns of a dilemma since any action against his son would estrange him from the Communists, while by separating from Mme. Chiang he would alienate the sympathies of the Soong financial dynasty, of which she is a member.
—Domei.

据传因将军之子对夫人采取敌对态度导致关系破裂；此举背后有共产党人的影响

东京，1月11日电——《朝日新闻》联播网驻香港记者在今天于此间发表的报道中称，蒋介石将军的基督教徒妻子蒋介石夫人与这位中国军事领袖的“红色”儿子蒋经国之间的摩擦，正有演变成重庆“第一家庭”内部一场高级别“战争”的危险。

该记者根据从香港的一位中国显要难民处获得的信息报道称，蒋夫人已向其丈夫下达了最后通牒。她的要求是：
1. 禁止蒋经国或其母亲陈洁如女士（译者注：原文如此）进入蒋将军的官邸，或者
2. 同意与蒋夫人分居。

记者引用其消息灵通人士的话称，这起麻烦源于蒋经国经常反对蒋夫人干涉——内政。蒋经国在经历了长期的疏远后于1937年从莫斯科回国，在此期间他曾谴责其父亲，讲述了蒋将军据传对陈洁如女士的残酷虐待。

采取新策略

当这些抱怨收效甚微时，据称蒋经国便采取了新策略。他开始带他的母亲进入重庆的中国上流社会，并在那里恭敬地将她介绍为“我的母亲”。

这令蒋夫人大为光火，以至于她向丈夫下达了最后通牒。

记者指出，蒋将军发现自己处于两难境地，因为对他的儿子采取任何行动都会使他与共产党人疏远，而与蒋夫人分居则会失去宋氏财政王朝的同情，而她是该王朝的成员。
——同盟社。

NIPPO

THIRD SPECIAL DISTRICT IN HANKOW TRANSFERRED TO
JAPANESE: STRANGE BRITISH ATTITUDE

A telegram received from our
special correspondent at Hankow reports that the Japanese
soldiers are engaged in mopping up work. On October 28
the Japanese military authorities took over the refugee
zone in south street and picked out a large number of
Chinese soldiers from among the refugees.
On October 29 the Japanese
military authorities took over the ex-British concession.
The Japanese army is now maintaining peace and order over
the whole of Hankow, except in the French Concession.
When the National Government recovered the British
Concession at Hankow, the area became known as the Third
Special Administrative District. With the Japanese
occupation of Hankow, the British authorities detailed
soldiers to protect their interests and rights by erecting
barbed wires along the boundary. On October 28 the
British authorities attempted to prevent the Sano
Detachment from entering the area. Later the British
Military attache at Hankow called on the Commander of the
Sano Detachment and requested him not to send Japanese
soldiers into the British sector, but the Japanese
Commander insisted on taking over the guarding of the
whole of Hankow, except the French Concession. It has
thus been decided to take over the Third Special Administrative
district.

MILITARISTS AND CAPITALISTS IN SZECHUAN OPPOSE
CHIANG KAI SHEK'S ENTRY INTO PROVINCE

The relations between Chiang
Kai Shek and the militarists and capitalists in Szechuan,
which were already bad prior to the fall of Hankow, are
reported to have become aggravated after the fall of Wuhan.
According to information received
from reliable sources, when the Japanese forces landed in
Bias Bay, Chiang Kai Shek mobilized some ten steamers
belonging to the Min Sung Industrial Company at Ichang
to transfer to Szechuan the central army of 80,000 under
the command of Hu Chung Nan and Liu Shih. When this matter
came to the knowledge of the militarists and capitalists
in Szechuan Province, they became highly indignant and
decided to oppose the entry of the Central soldiers. The

is attempted. General Tang, who has been fighting in

the pretext of attacking the Japanese but, in reality,

10月29日，日本军方接管了原英租界。除法租界外，日军现在维持着整个汉口的治安秩序。
当国民政府收回汉口英租界时，该地区被称为第三特别行政区。随着日军占领汉口，英国当局派遣士兵沿边界架设铁丝网，以保护其利益和权利。10月28日，英国当局试图阻止佐野支队进入该区域。随后，驻汉口英国武官拜访了佐野支队指挥官，请求其不要派遣日军进入英方辖区，但日本指挥官坚持要接管除法租界外的整个汉口的警戒任务。因此，决定接管第三特别行政区。

SCENE AT A RICE SHOP

At about 11.30 a.m. November 14, a crowd
of 400 persons assembled outside the Teh Tai Rice Shop
(德太米号), corner of Avenue and Myburgh Roads, anxious to
purchase rice. This shop has a large quantity of rice
in stock, but in view of the large number of people wishing
to make purchases, it suspended the sale for a time. When
the crowd demanded rice, sales were made through a small
opening. However, this irritated the crowd who broke
down the doors and carried away 80 piculs of rice from
the shop. There were about ten policemen present for
the purpose of maintaining order, but their efforts to restore
order were fruitless due to the high feeling among the
crowd. Fortunately, nobody was hurt.

SHANGHAI GODO

ANTI-MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POSTERS FOUND ON NANKING
ROAD AND FOOCHOW ROAD

A few days ago, a number of
posters of an anti-Municipal Council nature issued by
the Shanghai China National Salvation Association were
posted at various places on Nanking Road and Foochow
Road.

The contents of the posters
are as follows :-

"Whilst the whole nation is
resisting the enemy, economic conditions in Shanghai
underwent a great change and residents in the Settlement
are unable to pay the Municipal tax. As a result of the
interruption of communications, business has come to a
standstill and the purchasing power of the people has
greatly decreased. The people are not even able to
make a living, much less to pay the taxes to the Council.
The administration of the Settlement is controlled almost
exclusively by Britons with high salaries. The
Municipal authorities paid no attention to the welfare
of the Chinese residents during the hostilities, so that
the business of Chinese residents was greatly affected
and there is no hope of rehabilitation. How can the
Chinese residents stand this heavy burden?"

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated October 26 published the following
story written by one Woo Chung-hai (吳宗海) :-

THE EXPEDITION AGAINST THE DEVIL ISLAND BY MOMOTARU

On October 16 an article appeared in the
"Sin Wan Pao" stating that General Ma Pu-fang (馬步芳),
Governor of Tsinghai Province, was training a number of
monkeys. They are said to be as well disciplined as
human soldiers and will march towards any place where flags
of the rising sun are displayed. When face to face with
the enemy, these monkeys will jump upon them, tear out
their eyes and bite their throats.

This report recalls to my mind the story
commonly told in Japan about an expedition against a devil
island by Momotaru, in which monkeys took part.

It appears that at a certain place an old
woman was washing clothes by the side of a creek when there
floated down from up stream a very large peach and came to
a stop opposite the woman who picked it up and took it
home where, with the assistance of her husband, she cut
open the fruit and found a baby inside the fruit. The old
couple adopted the child and christened him Momotaru.

The boy grew strong and sturdy. At about this
time, many devils were coming from a devil island across
the sea and started to massacre the people and to loot their
homes. The people were powerless against them. Momotaru
requested permission to proceed to the devil island to
launch an expedition against the devils with a view to
subduing their rebellion. His request was granted. On
his way, he met a dog at the foot of a mountain, a monkey
in a forest and a pheasant in the wilderness. To each, he
gave a cake and they joined him.

（左侧批注：FILE / yB）
（左下角批注：208 / FILE / 3/10）
（底部文字：F. A. to D. C. (Sp. St.)）

10月26日出版的《大美晚报》（Ta Mei Wan Pao）刊登了
吴宗海（Woo Chung-hai）撰写的以下故事：-

桃太郎征讨鬼岛

10月16日，《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）刊登一篇文章称，
青海省主席马步芳（Ma Pu-fang）将军正在训练一批猴子。
据说这些猴子纪律严明，如同人类士兵一般，会向任何
悬挂旭日旗的地方进发。当与敌人面对面时，
这些猴子会扑向敌人，挖出他们的眼睛并咬断他们的喉咙。

这则报道让我想起日本广为流传的关于桃太郎
征讨鬼岛的故事，其中也有猴子参与。

故事似乎是这样的：在某地，一位老妇人
正在溪边洗衣服，这时上游漂下来一个很大的桃子，
停在老妇人对面。她捡起桃子带回家，在丈夫的帮助下
切开果实，发现里面有一个婴儿。老夫妇收养了这个孩子，
并给他取名为桃太郎。

男孩长得强壮结实。大约在此时，许多魔鬼
从海对面的鬼岛而来，开始屠杀百姓并掠夺他们的家园。
人们无力抵抗。桃太郎请求允许前往鬼岛，
发起征讨魔鬼的行动，以平定叛乱。他的请求获准。
在途中，他在山脚下遇到一只狗，在森林里遇到一只猴子，
在荒野中遇到一只雉鸡。他给每只动物一块蛋糕，
它们便加入了他。

（左侧批注：归档 / yB）
（左下角批注：208 / 归档 / 10月3日）
（底部文字：F. A. 致 D. C. (Sp. St.)）

- 2 -

Eventually they reached the devil island
but were denied admittance into the city. The pheasant
flew into the city and propagated amongst the inmates
the strength of Momotaru and urged them to surrender,
whereupon the devils became greatly excited and opened
the gates of the city wall to Momotaru and his party.

A large number of other devils then arrived,
but the pheasant pecked at their eyes, while the dog bit
their feet and the monkey scratched their faces. The king
of the devils put up a very strong resistance but he was
eventually overpowered and seized by Momotaru. The king
begged for mercy and was released.

Eventually, Momotaru and his party returned
home bringing with them a large quantity of precious
articles given them by the king of the devils. As a
result of this expedition, the devils became quiet and
ceased harming others. Thus the world was able to enjoy
peace.

To-day there are also devils in our country
who had also had come from overseas. They have killed and
robbed our people. Therefore, monkeys are being trained
in Tsinghai to take part in the fighting.

Young friends, you must be as brave as
Momotaru. We must improve our health so as to strengthen
our country. In order to avoid illness, you must
frequently take a medicine called "Er Pao" (兒宝).

(Translator's note:- This story is published
evidently as a sort of advertisement for a medicine for
children called "Er Pao").

- 2 -

最终他们到达了鬼岛，
但被拒绝入城。雉鸡飞入城中，
向居民宣扬桃太郎的强大力量并敦促他们投降，
于是魔鬼们大为惊恐，打开城门让桃太郎及其同伴进入。

随后大量其他魔鬼到来，
但雉鸡啄他们的眼睛，狗咬他们的脚，猴子抓他们的脸。
魔王进行了非常顽强的抵抗，但最终被桃太郎制服并抓获。
魔王乞求饶恕并被释放。

最终，桃太郎及其同伴带着魔王赠予的大量
珍贵物品返回家乡。由于这次征讨，魔鬼们变得安分，
不再害人。因此世界得以享受和平。

如今我国也有来自海外的魔鬼。他们杀害和抢劫
我们的人民。因此，青海正在训练猴子参战。

年轻的朋友们，你们必须像桃太郎一样勇敢。
我们必须改善健康以强国。为了避免生病，
你们必须经常服用一种名为“儿宝”（Er Pao）的药物。

（译者注：- 这个故事显然是作为一种名为“儿宝”的儿童药物的广告而发表的）。

Sin Wan Pao published the following article on Oct.. 16 :-

MONKEY SOLDIERS

During this war of resistance, a body of monkey
soldiers is being reported to have been organized.

The following is the summary of a letter received
from a certain person at the front, who had seen the
training of monkey soldiers in Tsinghai Province:-

"I have served as a war photographer at the front
since last year. I went to Shansi and Shensi Provinces in
company with the North-West Service Corps formed by the
Political Department of the Military Affairs Commission
in May this year. Yesterday we proceeded to Sian by way
of Tsinghai Province.

"The following is one of the things that we saw
on our way:- There are in all six or seven regiments of
monkey soldiers trained by Ma Pu-fang (馬步芳), Governor
of Tsinghai Province. We have, however, seen only about
100 orangoutangs. They are very nimble and they are
larger than those usually seen at Kwenming. They are
dressed in uniform and each has four hand grenades hanging
from their breasts.

"It is said that these monkey soldiers are very
brave and will march towards places wherever flags of the
rising sun are displayed. As they are very nimble and
of small size, it is not easy to hit him even with
concentrated firing. When face to face with the Japanese,
they would jump upon them, tear out their eyes and then
bite their throats. They usually kill the Japanese in
this manner.

在此次抗战期间，据报道已组建了一支
猴子士兵部队。

以下是从前线某位目睹青海省猴子士兵训练的人士

“自去年以来，我一直在前线担任战地摄影师。今年5月，
我随军事委员会政治部组成的西北服务团前往山西和陕西两省。
昨天我们经由青海省前往西安。

“以下是我们在途中所见之一：- 青海省主席
马步芳（Ma Pu-fang）共训练了六七个团的猴子士兵。
然而，我们只看到了大约100只猩猩（orangoutangs）。它们非常敏捷，
体型比通常在昆明见到的要大。它们身穿制服，
每只胸前挂着四枚手榴弹。

“据说这些猴子士兵非常勇敢，会向任何
悬挂旭日旗的地方进发。由于它们非常敏捷且体型小，
即使集中射击也不易击中。当与日本人面对面时，
它们会扑向日本人，挖出他们的眼睛，然后咬断他们的喉咙。
它们通常以这种方式杀死日本人。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

"The sergeants are all human beings, but their
deputies are all monkeys. It is probably that all ranks
above that of sergeant are held by men. At the time of
our visit, these monkey soldiers were undergoing training.
They are well disciplined. After the training, they are
each given $0.10 by the sergeants. Upon receiving the
money, they would rush into the streets and buy fruit.
Should a shop assistant attempt to cheat them, they would
remain in front of the shop screaming and jumping about
until they are given full value for their ten cents."
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

“班长都是人类，但副手都是猴子。可能班长以上的
所有军衔均由人担任。在我们访问时，这些猴子士兵
正在接受训练。它们纪律严明。训练结束后，
班长会给每只猴子0.10元。拿到钱后，

SHANGHAI TIMES.

OCT 4 1938

First There Were Buffaloes,
Now There Are Monkeys

Well, we've had a fairly good crop of rumours out of the last war around this area, but the press correspondents are outdoing themselves these days. During the hostilities of 1932 there were all sorts of reports about herds of wild buffaloes being driven against the Japanese lines to smash their way through the barbed wire entanglements. Then there was the report about hundreds of Chinese "amazons" descending upon the Japanese trenches in a wild sortie against the foe.

But now we have the story from Tokyo, through Reuter, regarding thousands of monkeys who have been trained by the Chinese to fight in the defence of Hankow. Here is the report:

Five thousand orang-outangs trained to throw hand-grenades, seize machine-guns and assault company commanders will be used by the Chinese when the Japanese hurl themselves against Hankow—at least according to a cabled dispatch appearing in a Tokyo newspaper from its Kiukiang correspondent.

The Chinese Army, he says, has been capturing orang-outangs in the south-western provinces for the past 10 years and secretly training them to turn loose on attacking soldiers.

As the source of his report, the correspondent quotes "information reaching authentic quarters from a certain direction."

At a command, he says, the orang-outangs will dash into the enemy lines, scramble for machine-guns, assault company commanders—ordinary soldiers are apparently to be left alone—and throw hand-grenades.

Three thousand of these orang-outangs, he adds, are being held in Hankow in readiness to terrorize the Japanese when they arrive, and the remaining 2,000 at Wuchang, across the Yangtze from Hankow.

1938年10月4日

先有水牛，现在有猴子

好吧，上一场战争期间这一带流传过不少谣言，但如今的报社记者们更是青出于蓝。在1932年的战事期间，有各种各样的报道说成群的野水牛被驱赶冲向日军防线，以冲破铁丝网障碍。接着又有报道说数百名中国“亚马逊女战士”疯狂出击，突袭日军战壕。

但现在我们通过路透社收到了来自东京的消息，称中国人训练了数千只猴子用于保卫汉口。报道如下：

据九江通讯员发给东京一家报纸的电讯称，当日本人猛攻汉口时，中国人将动用五千只受过投掷手榴弹、夺取机枪和攻击连长训练的猩猩——至少该电讯是这么说的。

他说，过去10年来，中国军队一直在西南各省捕捉猩猩，并秘密训练它们，以便在进攻士兵时释放出来。

作为消息来源，该通讯员引用了“从某个方向传到权威部门的信息”。

他说，一声令下，猩猩就会冲入敌军防线，争抢机枪，攻击连长——普通士兵显然会被放过——并投掷手榴弹。

他补充说，其中三千只猩猩正留在汉口，准备在日本人到达时制造恐怖，其余两千只则在位于长江对岸、汉口对面的武昌。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
OCT 4 1938
WAR'S NEW TERROR

Of all the ghastly stories of atrocities in prepara-
tion, in connection with the Sino-Japanese conflict, surely no-
thing can be more terrible than the reported scheme of the
Chinese to let loose upon the Japanese armies as they near

to throw hand grenades, seize machine-guns and assault company
commanders. The story is credited to the Kiukiang corres-
pondent of a Tokyo newspaper, who states that for the past ten
years the Chinese army in the southwest provinces has been
secretly training these animals to turn them loose on attac-

arrive there, while a further two thousand will be held at
Wuchang for precisely the same purpose. At the word of command

the foe, scramble for machine-guns, pick out company officers
and assault them, and in their spare time indulge in a little
grenade throwing. Those who realize the enormous strength
of these apes can picture them picking up a machine-gun and
bending it between their teeth, or wrapping it round the head

ing the pins from grenades, and counting before throwing, has

在所有与中日冲突有关的、正在酝酿中的可怕暴行故事中， surely 没有什么比据报道的中国人的计划更可怕的了：当日本人逼近汉口时，向他们释放五千只受过训练的猩猩，这些猩猩已被教会投掷手榴弹、夺取机枪和袭击连长。这一说法归功于东京一家报纸的九江记者，他声称过去十年间，中国军队在西南各省一直秘密训练这些动物，以便在攻击士兵时将它们放出来。根据这位极具想象力的记者的说法，目前三千只猩猩正被扣留在汉口待命，以便在日军到达那里时制造恐怖，而另外两千只将被扣留在武昌，用于完全相同的目的。一声令下，这些高度训练的生物就会扑向敌人，争抢机枪，挑出连级军官并袭击他们，并在闲暇之余玩弄一下投掷手榴弹。那些意识到这些猿类巨大力量的人，可以想象它们拿起一挺机枪并用牙齿将其弯曲，或者将其缠绕在指挥官的头上，而看到成群的它们拉开手榴弹引信并在投掷前计数的情景，简直令人难以置信。不难理解，如果这个故事是真的，日本最高指挥部在制定应对这种全新威胁的方案时一定倍感艰难。到目前为止，据信唯一完善的计划是让普通士兵装扮成连长，预计这些聪明的野兽会因此彻底困惑，届时只需由身着普通士兵制服的连长手持……

"For the past 50 years, Japan has always

CHANGSHA WAS SET ON FIRE BY WHAMPOA CLIQUE TO
KILL CHOW UNG LAI AND KWOH MEI SHU

Information received from reliable sources on
November 22 revealed that the Changsha fire was caused by the
Whampoa Clique to kill Chow Ung Lai and Kwoh Mei Shu who
were in Changsha but who made good their escape. This
clique is opposed to Chiang Kai Shek's pro-communist policy.
Immediately after the fall of Hankow General Chen
Chung, Chow Ung Lai and other important communist leaders
went to Changsha. General Feng Ti, the Defence Commissioner
of Changsha, aid Wen Chung Fu, Commissioner of Police, who
are members of the Whampoa Clique, planned to kill the
communist leaders. Fifty places were set on fire by them.
Eight hundred members of the political training section
were burned to death or shot dead but Chow Ung Lai and Kwoh
Mei Shu escaped.
Chow Ung Lai lodged a strong protest with Chiang
Kai Shek who later executed Feng Ti and Police Commissioner
Won Chung Fu to prevent communist trouble. Foreign proper-
ties were reduced to ashes and about 10,000 people lost
their lives. The Changsha plot seems to have brought the
Kuomintang and the Communist party closer.

11月22日从可靠来源收到的消息显示，长沙大火系黄埔系所为，旨在杀害当时在长沙但成功逃脱的周恩来（Chow Ung Lai）和郭沫若（Kwoh Mei Shu）。该派系反对蒋介石的亲共政策。
汉口失陷后，陈诚将军、周恩来和其他重要的共产党领导人立即前往长沙。长沙卫戍司令冯蒂（Feng Ti，音译）警官、警察局长温忠福（Wen Chung Fu，音译，均为黄埔系成员）策划杀害共产党领导人。他们纵火焚烧了五十处地点。八百名政治训练班成员被烧死或枪杀，但周恩来和郭沫若逃脱。
周恩来向蒋介石提出强烈抗议，蒋介石随后处决了冯蒂和警察局长温忠福，以防止共产党制造麻烦。外国财产化为灰烬，约1万人丧生。长沙阴谋似乎使国民党和共产党更加接近。

Subject Repatriation of Refugees to Wenchow.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

The repatriation of local refugees is now undertaken by the International Red Cross, 505 Honan Road, which has a special "Refugees Repatriation Committee".
The procedure of repatriation is as follows :-
The Chiefs of Repatriation Sections of the Federation of Charity Organizations, 35 Yunnan Road, and the Shanghai Emergency Relief Committee, 1454 Avenue Edward VII, which are the two leading organizations looking after refugee camps, forward reports to the "Refugees Repatriation Committee" of the International Red Cross together with a list of refugees who are willing to be repatriated or who wish to proceed to the interior to their homes. These reports with the necessary application forms from each refugee are then despatched. The preliminaries having been completed, travelling tickets are then issued by the "Refugees Repatriation Committee" to the Federation of Charity Organizations, who in turn distribute them to the refugees through the chiefs of the various camps under its control and the Shanghai Emergency Relief Committee. At present only one route is available for repatriation of refugees to the interior and that is by Wenchow.
Altogether 111 refugees were repatriated during the month of August.
No confirmation of these refugees being recruited for the Chinese Military can be obtained.

SENSATIONAL DESPATCH
BY CORRESPONDENT

Flurry In Hankow Circles
Owing To Rumours Of
Early Japan Drive

TOKYO, June 30.—President
Lin Sen, of the Chinese Nation-
alist Government, has decided
to resign and to urge Chiang
Kai-shek to follow suit in case
Hankow is occupied by Japan-
ese troops, the Hongkong
correspondent of the "Nichi-
Nichi" reported in a sensational
despatch to-day.

The correspondent reported also
that the Nationalist Government will
transfer its offices to Chungking and
Yunnanfu, but Chiang Kai-shek is
"contemplating seeking refuge in
Omeishan, in Szechwan Province.

Uneasiness at Hankow

Quoting reliable information from
Hankow, the correspondent reported
that "extreme unrest is prevailing
in Hankow, where it is persistently
rumoured that Japanese forces are
planning not only to cut the Can-
ton-Hankow Railway south of Wu-
chang but to carry out drives on
Nanchang, capital of Kiangsi Pro-
vince, and Changsha, capital of
Hunan."

In this event, the correspondent
reported, the Hankow Government
would lose its line of communication
with South China, "while it is fear-
ed that Chinese troops would be
threatened with annihilation, part-
ly by Japanese forces and partly
by flood."

Postal Staff Leaves

The correspondent claimed also
that the Chinese Post Office staff
of about 500 left Hankow on June
26 and June 27 for Yunnanfu.

This fact, coupled with the evacua-
tion of foreign residents on
June 25 caused by the situation
in Hankow, the correspondent de-
clared.

"A panic is widespread in Hankow
Government circles as a result
of the above developments. It is
believed that the Government will
leave Hankow within a few days."

东京，6月30日。——据《日日新闻》驻香港记者今日发出的一则轰动性电讯称，中国国民政府主席林森已决定辞职，并敦促蒋介石在汉口被日军占领的情况下亦步后尘。

该记者还报道说，国民政府将把办公地点迁往重庆和云南府，但蒋介石正“考虑前往四川省峨眉山避难”。

汉口方面的不安

该记者援引来自汉口的可靠消息报道称，“汉口普遍存在极度不安情绪，那里持续流传着日军不仅计划切断武昌以南的粤汉铁路，还将对江西省省会南昌和湖南省省会长沙发动进攻的谣言。”

记者报道说，在这种情况下，汉口政府将失去与中国南方的交通联络线，“同时人们担心，中国军队将面临被歼灭的威胁，部分来自日军，部分来自洪水。”

邮政人员撤离

该记者还声称，约500名中国邮政局工作人员已于6月26日和27日离开汉口前往云南府。

记者宣称，这一事实，加上因汉口局势导致的外国居民于6月25日撤离，

August 27, 1938.

NIPPO

BOGUS LOCAL "TANGPU" WHEEDLES PUBLIC OUT OF
THEIR MONEY

The local "Tangpu", the organ
which directed the anti-Japanese campaign in this
locality prior to the hostilities, left this city for
the interior together with General Chiang's regime,
therefore it does not exist at present.

Some members of the Kuomintang,
however, have since smuggled themselves into this
city. By means of newspapers, magazines and handbills
they have announced the revival of the local "Tangpu"
at the various anniversaries and urged the public to
contribute money and property to the national Government
and to hoist the national flag at anniversaries. This
bogus "Tangpu" with the object of wheedling the public out
of their money, has sent a large number of letters to
Chinese residing in foreign areas south of the Soochow
Creek requesting them to contribute the interest on
Patriotic Bonds.

This step was taken by the
local Tangpu on instructions from the National Government
in order to hide the government's financial difficulties.
The National Government must pay to bond-holders $20,000,000
in interest at the end of August; but the authorities
have no funds to meet the payment.

The bogus local "Tangpu" had
previously swindled the public of a large sum of money
under the pretext of relief for refugees. More recently
the organ wheedled the public out of their money by asking
for contributions to General Chiang's regime on the
occasions of the anniversary on July 7 and August 13.

假冒的地方“党部”诱骗公众钱财

地方“党部”是战前在本地区指挥反日运动的机构，已随蒋介石政权撤离本市前往内地，因此目前该机构已不存在。

然而，此后一些国民党成员偷偷潜入本市。他们通过报纸、杂志和传单，宣布在各类纪念日恢复地方“党部”，并敦促公众向国民政府捐献钱物，以及在纪念日悬挂国旗。这个假冒的“党部”以诱骗公众钱财为目的，向大量居住在苏州河以南外侨居住区的华人发送信件，要求他们缴纳爱国公债的利息。

此举是地方党部奉国民政府指示采取的，目的是掩盖政府的财政困难。国民政府必须在八月底向债券持有人支付20,000,000美元的利息；但当局没有资金来支付这笔款项。

此前，假冒的地方“党部”曾以救济难民为借口，从公众手中骗取了大量钱财。最近，该机构又在7月7日和8月13日的纪念日之际，以向蒋介石政权捐款为名，诱骗公众钱财。

GENERAL TSAI CHING-CHUN EXECUTED IN NANKING

General Tsai Ching-chun, Commissioner of the

P.M. 8/12/37

GENERAL YANG HU EXECUTED AT HANGCHOW

Recently General Yang Hu, the former Woosung-
Shanghai Defence Commissioner, proceeded to Hangchow.
After entertaining him, the Mayor of Hangchow produced
a telegram from General Chiang Kai-shek reading as
follows :- "General Yang Hu had formed mobile units in
Shanghai and extorted money from residents, definite proof
of which has been secured. The members of the mobile
units are all bad elements and when Nantao fell, many
of them surrendered to the Japanese. The senior officer
should be held responsible for all this and should be
executed on the spot for violation of the military law".
General Yang Hu could not do anything after
reading the telegram. He was executed after the dinner.
It is learned that General Hsiung Shih-hwei,
Chairman of the Kiangsi Provincial Government, has been
discharged, while another report says that the General
has also been executed.
- 8 DEC. 1937

1937年12月8日下午

杨虎将军在杭州被处决

近日，前吴淞-上海防卫专员杨虎将军前往杭州。杭州市长在宴请他之后，出示了一封蒋介石将军的电报，内容如下：“杨虎将军在上海组建流动部队，并向居民勒索钱财，此事已有确凿证据。该流动部队成员皆为不良分子，南市失陷时，其中许多人向日军投降。高级军官应对此负全部责任，并因违反军法就地处决。”

杨虎将军读完电报后束手无策。他在晚宴后被处决。

据悉，江西省政府主席熊式辉将军已被免职，另有消息称该将军也被处决。
- 1937年12月8日
